summary: Boundary County, ID: 1921 cabin and 1935 pole tower; 53-ft tower built 1963 at Faset Peak, moved 1975 to Black Mountain and 2019 half a mile; closed, restoration disputed.

facts.design: Current 53-foot open timber tower with a Region 6 flat-top cab; earlier 40-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab (1935) and a 1921 cabin on a short tower
facts.status_note: Moved about half a mile east-northeast in 2019; stands at the new site. Sources disagree on how much restoration remains.
facts.agency: Idaho Department of Lands (administered per NHLR; last staffed 1997); Idaho Panhandle National Forests (Kaniksu) per Campflare

access.note: Campflare lists it as not available for rental; restoration is needed before it can open to the public through the recreation rental program

corrections.why: NHLR describes the current structure as a 53 foot open timber tower (16.2 m). 12.2 m is 40 feet, the height of the 1935 pole tower, so the record appears to carry the earlier tower's height.

corrections.current: Only 1963 built and a 'None relocated' entry (the record says it was moved to Black Mountain Ridge)
corrections.proposed: Add 1975 relocated (Faset Peak to Black Mountain) and 2019 relocated (half a mile ENE of the original site)
corrections.why: NHLR and firelookout.com both record the 1975 move, and NHLR records the 2019 move; the record omits both.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and firelookout.com give 1975. The Idaho Fire Lookouts timeline gives 1976, but the August newspaper note it quotes describes the move in 1975. 1975 is used and the 1976 date is noted.

Boundary County Historic Places says the tower is complete and awaiting rental inclusion. Campflare says restoration is still needed before the tower can open to the public. Access is set to closed per Campflare, whose listing is undated.
NHLR says the Idaho Department of Lands administers the site; Campflare says the Idaho Panhandle National Forests manage it. Both are recorded in the agency fact.

notes_for_editor: Describes the same tower as us-id-black-mountain-at-black-mountain-ridge (both cite NHLR US 1464); consider merging the two records. The record coordinates (48.61038, -116.2577) nearly match the NHLR listing, but NHLR says the tower moved half a mile ENE in 2019, so the point may be the old site; verify before use. Campflare and Boundary County Historic Places pages are undated, so the restoration status may have changed. A search snippet mentioned a 1997 rental placement and a 2002 magazine rate; neither page was read, so neither is used. No photos added (the Idaho Fire Lookouts photo credit is unlicensed).
